plugin.name: xkill
plugin._long: Turns the cursor into a crosshair. The next left click on a window force-kills the client that owns it, similar to the X11 `xkill` utility. Right click or Escape cancels without killing anything.

option.name: activate
option._long: Starts crosshair mode. Left-click a window to kill it; right-click or Escape cancels.
